title: Trustless Agents (ERC-8004) Call #2, October 22, 2025
agendaMarkdown:
​📋 Agenda

​🧩 Spec Recap — What’s New

- ​Quick overview of the finalized ERC-8004 spec and recent updates since v1 launch.

​🧱 Reference Implementation & Deployment Addresses

- ​Walk-through of the deployed contracts and validation registries live on-chain.

​⚙️ SDKs & DevEx Presentation — How to Build in Practice

- ​Leonard and team demo the new developer tools: registration card generator, TypeScript/Python SDKs, and example integrations.

​🪩 Trustless Agent Day @ Devconnect — Event Preview

​- Presentation of the upcoming AI Builders event in Buenos Aires — agenda, speakers, and how to participate.

​🚀 Demo Time

​- Showcase of early ERC-8004-compliant agent builds from the community.

​💬 Q&A + Open Discussion

​- Ask questions, share feedback, and connect with other builders working on trustless agent infrastructure.
